column1: # What a call holds and how long the line waits: a name, a number.
# `caller`: how many are in one room's call. A call is a mesh, every
# caller connected to every other, so it stays small.
caller
# `watch`: how many pages may hold one room's line.
watch
# `beat`: a line that says nothing is told a beat this often, in
# milliseconds, so nothing between closes a quiet stream. `gone`: a page
# that took no beat for this long went away, and is dropped.
beat
gone
# `send`: how many signals one post may pass on.
send
# `body`: how many bytes a request may be. `wire`: how many pages the
# line serves at once, every room together. `session`: how many guests
# it remembers.
body
wire
session
# `tick`: how often the line looks whether it was closed, in milliseconds.
tick
